author: claude-fable-5-1
visual_review_findings: Compared the original (two flamed candles in a Y holder with a foot beside a scored loaf) with the rejected drawing (bare candle strokes with dot flames on a long-stemmed Y, reading as a y with an umlaut, beside a small D) at 48px in both themes. Redrew with outlined candle bodies under flame strokes, a goblet holder of two r8 arcs on a stem, and a domed two-cubic bun at the lower right. Native review: candles read as candles, the holder as a candelabra stem, the bun as bread.
omissions: loaf score marks, holder foot, teardrop flame outlines (no vertical room above outlined candles)
construction_reference: no direct Lucide match; candle bodies as outlined boxes, bun as a two-cubic dome
